title: •Brainiac
caption: •Brainiac (V)
game_text: X = Light Side cards in hand. Y = Dark Side cards in hand. If X < Y, your Force generation is +1. If X = Y, adds one battle destiny. Once per turn, if X > Y, may lose a card from hand to make a just drawn weapon or battle destiny = π.
lore: BoShek nicknamed this male Siniteen ‘Brainiac’ due to his ability to calculate hyperspace coordinates in his head. “He’s the brains, sweetheart!”
